title: Mazloom Syed Da Taboot Hai Logo Jidi Laash Chayi Mazdooran Ney
body:
Tak Mayyat Nu Phul Baghdad Dey Beywaris Paye Vain Arsh Tey Hooran Ney
<<DIVIDER>>
Ik Waqt Ch Do Mayyatan Uthiyan Baghdad Vicho
Ik Shehar Tey Ik Zindaano
Do Pyun Puttaran Day Dil Tukray Keetay Haye Zehar Alood Angooran Ney
<<DIVIDER>>
Gharon Turdiyan Pyun Nu Vekh Ke Dhiyan Kehn Paiyan
Pehle Siran Vich Mittiyan Paiyan
Tere Baaj Baba Kaleyan Nahi Jee Sakna, Teriyan Dhiyan Majbooran Ney
<<DIVIDER>>
Ik Bachri Pak Imam Di Shehar Iran Andar
Beywarisan Wangu Rulgayi
Jinay Veer Nu Labdeya Pak Rida Laa Layi Junglan Vich Ud Diyan Dhoolan Ney
<<DIVIDER>>
Hain Kaun Zanjeer Lahavay Es Musafir De
Jeyra Ruleya Vich Pardesan
Aaye Vehn Mayyat Tey Fatima Zahra De Sunay Shehar Diyan Mastooran Ney
